desc.en: Beijing suburban railway is a means of transportation in Beijing. As of July 2026, Beijing has opened four suburban railway lines, namely S2 Line, Urban Sub center Line, Huairou Miyun Line, and Tongmi Line, with a total operating mileage of 370 kilometers and 26 stations, ranking at the forefront of the country. In the future, the suburban railway in Beijing will form a development scale of nearly 1000 kilometers, forming a well structured, hierarchical, and functionally complete urban rail transit network system with the subway and regional express lines, meeting the diverse travel needs of Beijing citizens and promoting the development of green transportation in Beijing.
desc.zh-Hans: 北京市郊铁路，是北京市的一种交通工具。截至2026年7月，北京已经开通了4条市郊铁路线路，分别是S2线、城市副中心线、怀柔-密云线、通密线，运营总里程达到370公里，车站26座，处于全国领先水平。未来，北京市郊铁路将会形成近1000公里的发展规模，与地铁、区域快线组成结构合理、层次分明、功能完善的北京城市轨道交通网络体系，满足北京市民多样化出行需求，助力北京绿色交通发展。
